action.objective: Preserve the extra rook with a safe king move, then push passed pawns.
action.rationale: Both legal moves score +715 exact at depth 4. Kf2 is verified commit_ready: safety complete with no mate-in-one, tactical_refutation and checking_chain both not_found, opponent has no immediate captures on f2. Kf2 keeps the king off the c-file, avoids the rook's c1-c2 check line complexity, and stays central to support the d5/e6 passed pawns. Kf1->e2 scores +715 but is only an upper bound, meaning the real score could be worse. Commit Kf2.
